evidence: Implements BIP 54 consensus validation rules in src/validation.cpp, src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp, and src/consensus/consensus.h.
rationale: Implements BIP 54 (Consensus Cleanup) validation rules to resolve legacy vulnerabilities including quadratic sigops, Merkle collisions (CVE-2017-12842), and timewarp attacks. As the rules are activated only on regtest via BIP 9 versionbits without mainnet activation, delay does not risk immediate consensus divergence, but the PR provides substantial strategic value by enabling testing and vetting of proposed consensus changes.
